resources.string: Developer preview build. The production UX of Phase 13 lands on this shell.
No connection — content stays readable, sends queue
Developer preview. No privacy property is verified at this stage.
A phone that is compromised defeats GHOST. What reduces the damage: a dedicated device for high-risk work, and keeping the system updated.
For high-risk profiles use a dedicated device, for example one running GrapheneOS.
Your provider sees that you use Tor. Resistance, not immunity.
Creating the local keys. Nothing leaves this device.
The PIN locks the app when you are away. A fingerprint or face can be used against your will; a PIN in your head cannot. Anyone holding your unlocked phone is what this lock does not stop.
High changes the pacing of traffic and delays some checks. The choice applies from now on: the access you receive next follows this mode.
Write them on paper, keep them offline. Never photograph them, never type them into another app or site. GHOST asks for them only at restore.
Type the words at the positions GHOST asks for. A mistake shows the words again and asks a new check — there is no skip.
GHOST shows one constant message, never its text, never a count, hidden on the lock screen. Listener apps, watches and the system usage records see when it appears.
What this deletes: every message and contact on this phone, your access tokens and unused credits, your identity keys. Copies others hold stay with them; relay copies stay until their time runs out.
Deleted files and keys are as final as this phone storage and its key store allow. Your identity can come back only from the 24 words.
The keys of this phone no longer open the GHOST data. Try again; if it still fails, the data cannot be read anymore: delete it and restore the identity from the 24 words.
Paying from an exchange with identity checks links you to an invoice. The Monero network sees the broadcast moment and your wallet fingerprint. Prefer your own wallet over Tor, at a random moment.
No refund. The exact amount only - a shortfall can be topped up inside the window, nothing extra is returned.
Do not add a lock time. Send unlocked.
You have 24 hours to pay; confirmation can take up to 72 hours. You can pay from another device or later.
Sync pauses while this screen is open and for 20-60 minutes after it closes.
After pasting the address into a wallet, compare its first and last six characters: a keyboard or a clipboard tool can replace it.
The tokens arrive after the network confirms - from minutes to days. GHOST shows one constant message when it happens; nothing else changes here.
No conversations yet. Scan a contact card to start one.
Where did you see this code?
On the phone of the person, in front of me
In a photo, a message, a video call or on another screen
Compare the safety number in person before trusting this contact.
Write it on paper and tell members in person; do not copy it
At most 9 channels per device; at least 2 funders recommended
This link appears once; the person you invite opens it before it expires
You are already a member of this channel
This channel is protected; type its 5-word passphrase
Wait for a moderator approval; it can take hours
You appear under the same pseudonym as in any earlier channel with this identifier
The photo is re-encoded before it is sent; the original stays in your gallery
The relays see that you stopped the downloads

In high-privacy mode, sends leave after a random delay of up to 10 minutes, the app reads less at each check, and new access becomes usable a few days later. Traffic volume stays visible: GHOST sends no cover traffic.
Every row states what an actor sees at least, what it should not see (a design goal, not yet verified), and the proof from the claims register. A goal becomes a claim only through the register.
blob hashes, a size bucket, the opaque channel namespace, a capability or nullifier, an approximate moment, one Tor circuit
your IP address, your identity, content, channel membership beyond co-occurrence, the social graph, anything about payment
the uniform amount of a payment and its moment, with no sender (Monero), the number of tokens issued, the referral commitment credited, a referrer payout subaddress
the GHOST identity, which token is used where and when, the IP address
the destination, the content, the real sizes, who your correspondents are
the per-channel pseudonym, the content, the time to the minute
your base identity without a reveal, your participation in other channels, your IP address
your base identity, the content, the safety number
your IP address, your channels, unless one was revealed to them
anything above; payment, identity and traffic cannot be linked — today a goal, not a verified property
the amount, the sender, the recipient

the channel pseudonyms, the join requests, the content

at an install or update, Play Protect may send Google the app details or the APK, and the developer verification may look the install up (DC-28)
Apps with usage-access or notification access
when a notification appears and the system usage records; the notification carries no content (DC-19, DC-30)
Private preview build. No privacy property of this build is verified yet, and there is no way to report abuse through the app; screenshots are blocked.
